title: Major Buzz & Leutnant von Zip - fight against a fly brain!
author: HeralaiasYak
selftext:
If you missed the news, a full connectome of a fruit fly (think of it like a map of all the neuronal connections) was published recently and open sourced. I took that connectome, trained the network to fly a tiny airplane and built a cosy apartment for the two fruitfly ace pilots to fly through. 

Tools used:

Practically all assets made with either Trello or Meshy.   
2D artwork and assets - gpt image  
Code - mostly Opus 5.5  
Audio - Elevenlabs  
Trailer was also 'directed' by Opus. 

If anyone has questions, I'm happy to talk more about the process. 

you can take your chances on itch:

[https://cambrian-games.itch.io/major-buzz](https://cambrian-games.itch.io/major-buzz)

and the info about the connectome:  
[https://research.google/blog/a-connectomics-milestone-mapping-the-complete-male-fruit-fly-brain/](https://research.google/blog/a-connectomics-milestone-mapping-the-complete-male-fruit-fly-brain/)
